text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I'd have a meal at a cafe for a 
change... but it's quite crowded."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...What a pain after all. I'm not 
particularly hungry anyway, so who cares.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Meals can be prepared even in the middle 
of the night, and in the first place, 
anything works as long as you get 
nutrition—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what am I going to do...!? I gained 
weight... again!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whyyy? I made sure not to eat ramen for a 
late-night snack and everything!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even though I made sure my 
post-late-night-snack snack was low in 
calories too~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan... I think that might be the 
reason, you know?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I need to eat properly for breakfast, 
lunch, and dinner, and cut back on 
midnight snacks... or else, well...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu... It is just as you sayyy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, prepare three wholesome meals 
a day for me for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, please also take into 
consideration the timing of when meals are 
served."

For a while after that, I prepared the 
meals as instructed and brought them to 
the lab.

Thanks to a well-regulated diet, it seemed 
Agnes Tachyon had shed some excess body 
fat.
